title: Freeze each arm as a ClassifierBundle and verify reloaded predictions offline
description:
## Purpose

Freeze each arm's S4 version as a core `ClassifierBundle` and prove that reloading changes nothing.

## Scope

Save F, F-rand, A-c and A-c+F (and the replayed 0 / A / D-v1 / A+D-v1 where meaningful) as bundles: `bundle.json` committed text-free, `examples.jsonl` private and never committed, `scorecard.yaml` hashed. Lineage records harness, core and Jev-Flywheel clone commits.

## Definition of done

Offline (fake engine and cached answers): reloaded bundles give identical predictions to the in-memory versions; bundle hashes recorded here. Cost: $0. Part of the way to **S5**.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §1.2, §6 step 9.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-7284b9aa-7c87-4bd4-b5d3-f7a67546cbdd`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

comments.text: Offline done (core f2efcfc; Evaluations 48d40de, 4a9e39f). Every run now freezes 0, A, A-c, F, F-rand and A-c+F at the end of its last round under run_dir/bundles/<arm>/round-<n> (bundle.json text-free and hashed; examples.jsonl private; scorecard.yaml = the arm's Jev-Flywheel Score), and the summary records the hashes. Specs: a reloaded bundle gives identical predictions to the in-memory classifier for all six arms (cached answers), and a reloaded list bundle sends the same request (fresh fake Jev, no cache); manifests text-free; a changed bundle on rerun is kept beside the new one (round-N.superseded-<hash>). The Phase 1 live F/F-rand runs replay at $0 and freeze as bundles (0 ba62db0d8567, F 631608998ec0, F-rand fe1bc2b97795 in a scratch replay). The S4 bundle hashes (A-c, A-c+F) come after the live rounds.
